items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: No, I don't really know Fulco.

ctx.x: He left town in... Galador. He left town in about 35. He played at the Orpheum for a long time. Yeah. With Joe Fulco. Mm-hmm. I thought you might remember him.
No, I don't really know Fulco. Yeah, he and...
He and Boris... Howard Glories were in the band, I think, and... Mike Kaplan. You know Mike Kaplan? Yeah, I don't know Mike Kaplan.
